title: Find the Missing Alt Text
description: Given a snippet, identify which images lack proper alt text and suggest improvements.
problemStatement: ## Fix the Alt Text Examine this HTML snippet: ```html ``` Identify which images are missing proper alt text or have poor alt text, and for each, describe what you would write instead.
hints: An empty alt attribute means the image is decorative. Is logo.svg decorative?
The third image has no alt attribute at all.
The last image has a file name as alt text – that's not helpful.
expectedOutput: Image 1: alt="" – fine if decorative; Image 3: missing alt – must be added; Image 4: alt should be descriptive, e.g., 'Bar chart showing quarterly sales growth'.
solutionCode:
Image 1: alt="" (decorative logo – good)
Image 2: alt="Our team of volunteers" – already acceptable.
Image 3: needs alt, e.g., "Warning: high temperature alert".
Image 4: replace alt with meaningful description like "Line chart of user signups from January to June 2025."
